purity_traces_doc61_SS9_3.reading_doc61_SS9_2: the per-WIRE trace is read against doc 61 SS9.2's PRE-COMPUTED INVENTORY as its baseline, NOT against 1: a generic unit vector in R^{2^q} is not a product of q single-qubit states, so the intro per-wire purity is below 1 BY CONSTRUCTION and is a DATA-DETERMINED CONSTANT OF THE ENCODING, not a circuit effect. A3 min/median/max 0.5036/0.6660/0.9693; A4 0.5046/0.5299/0.7924; NO NOUN IS WITHIN 0.05 OF A PRODUCT STATE at either rung. Here the mechanism is MAXIMAL AND UNAVOIDABLE, and it is the ENCODING, not a gate.
purity_traces_doc61_SS9_3.registered_question_doc61_SS9_4: does the readout restore the per-REGISTER purity to its INTRO value (1.0, by construction) on correct q = 2 items and fail to on q = 1 items -- the q-asymmetry undo signature (doc 55 SS20.5) transposed from wires to registers? DESCRIPTIVE, NO BOOLEAN, NO CRITERION. The healthy committed profile is the wire-level one (R2-A: 0.8755 vs 0.8751 on correct q = 2; 0.8017 vs 0.8953 on q = 1).
purity_traces_doc61_SS9_3.no_promotion_doc61_SS9_5: these traces MAY describe how an arm succeeds or fails. They MAY NOT be promoted onto a criterion after results exist (the exp44 no-promotion clause), and NO VERDICT READS THEM.

A3-T1-uniform.contamination_rule: doc 61 SS15.5: if a floor RISES TO MEET ITS ARM the cell is reported as floor-contaminated with BOTH numbers and IS NOT READ. Operationalised here, transparently, as floor_mean >= 0.65 (the floor itself reaches the binding bar) OR arm_mean - floor_mean < 0.06 (the separation is inside the registered resolution). At 408 parameters against 528 items this is A LIVE RISK AND NOT A FORMALITY.
A3-T1-uniform.floor_construction: doc 61 SS15.1: the committed S-shuffle (`exp69_run.relabel_shuffle_q`, imported unchanged) -- bearer designation reassigned PER PAIR, independently of the features -- same items, same splits, same 5 seeds, run under the IDENTICAL ARM PROCEDURE. **THE INIT IS PART OF THE PROCEDURE, so each cell carries its OWN floor** (doc 58 SS14's argument, inherited: a floor measured under one optimisation procedure does not bound what another can achieve on severed labels).
